title: kanban: card footer with comment and attachment counts and time in column
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36370 (PR #36411, kanban gets its own view settings). The card asked for a toggle for the card footer icons. The seat left it out of #36411 because nothing can fill it yet. Filed by the seat. Parent: #36370.

## What happens

A kanban card has no footer that shows how many comments or attachments a record has, or how long it has been in its column. The data for it is not there: the board reads no per-card comment or attachment count, and no record carries a time it entered its current stage.

## To do

1. Measure where a per-card comment and attachment count can come from in one query for the whole board (no read per card).
2. Measure whether a stage-entered time exists (field history or the activity stream) or must be stored.
3. Then add the footer and its view setting, as one change with its reader.

## Acceptance

- A board with the setting on shows the counts and the time in column on every card, from a single read for the board; with it off, nothing is read.

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui. A missing feature the card named, not a defect.
